name: Multiply sigmas in an index window
plain: Multiplies only the sigmas whose index falls in a window given as fractions of the list length, counting the final 0. With the defaults (0 to 1) it scales every entry, the same as a plain multiply. The window is by position in the list, not by sigma value. Scaling the first entry also changes the starting noise level the sampler assumes, so a factor other than 1 at the start changes how much noise the latent starts with.
math:
Symbols: σ list of N values (including the final 0); k factor; s, e window fractions.
σ'_i = k·σ_i if ⌊s·N⌋ ≤ i < ⌊e·N⌋, else σ_i.
